entities.name: Henri François Xavier de Belsunce de Castelmoron
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henri François Xavier de Belsunce de Castelmoron was a French Jesuit who served as Bishop of Marseille from 1709 until his death. He is remembered for his tireless efforts to relieve the suffering during the Great Plague of Marseille of 1720–21.
